title: Deathknell sequence order inverted: the 'draw 2' executes before the 'Discard 2' choice is made
expected: Undercover Agent has no hand-authored abilities (riftbound-cards/src/cards/ogn/undercover-agent.ts), so enrich-cards.ts parses rulesText; for "[Deathknell] — Discard 2, then draw 2." effect-keyword-parser.ts:240-250 emits `{type:"sequence", effects:[{discard 2},{draw 2}]}` (verified by running parseAbilities) rather than a discard with a `then` clause. handle_sequence (riftbound-engine/src/abilities/effects/sequence.ts:268) executes each step in turn; handle_discard (effects/discard.ts:53-66) parks a `reveal-and-pick` pendingChoice (revealed = pre-draw hand, then = undefined) and returns, but sequence.ts:276-288 only suspends remaining steps when the parked choice is `choose-mode`, so the loop proceeds and runs the draw step immediately while the discard prompt is still pending. This exactly produces the observed draw-before-discard ordering with the pick list limited to the pre-draw hand.
observed: On resolving the Deathknell chain item, deck went 35->33 and hand 5->7 (Legion Rearguard + Chemtech Enforcer / Seal of Rage + Doran's Ring drawn) immediately, and only then a pendingChoice {type:'reveal-and-pick', onPicked:'discard', remaining:2} appeared. The pick list was restricted to the 5 pre-draw hand cards (so net card outcome matches), but the draw visibly happened before the discard decision, leaking information and contradicting the 'then' ordering.
